s15.title: 1690 Orbit | World Champions | Behind the Bumpers | FRC CRESCENDO Robot (auto-caption)

bet.text: Build the shortest, lowest, lightest (to a reasonable extent) and simplest robot possible, with climb and trap only as additions on the main systems.

demand.text: The team decided early not to compromise speaker, amp and fast cycles for anything else. The trap was a "nice to have" on top of existing mechanisms. It set a good-enough shooting distance and focused on making its shots, even if that meant driving a few extra feet.

auto.text: A seven-piece routine. If the robot reaches the midline and has not picked up a note, it turns, looks for one, leaves the planned path to collect it, then returns to the path, shoots and carries on.

cycle.text: An under-bumper intake takes the note and the trigger rollers feed it at almost any arm angle. The driver drives and presses one button; the robot sets shooter angle, heading and wheel speed. Shots use the estimated pose, so they work without seeing tags.

endgame.text: Light arms open, the hooks pull off magnets as the climb starts, and winches are corrected for roll. One servo releases spring-driven slides and fingers that open the trap door, and the shooter fires in time with the swing.

fallback.text: The championship plan: coming back with under 18 seconds and no amplification in sight, take that note to the trap (under 10 seconds if another note is easy to reach).

gave_up.text: Squeezing the note so the shooter stows between the modules meant spin was not reliable, so the shot has none.

An unsigned post that reads as the team's warns copiers that other spin shooters, larger intakes, downward amp mechanisms and closer trap mechanisms work better; only being very low was perfected. A reply counters that its true strength is being fast and controllable.

changed.text: Both losses before the championship came from a note stuck beneath the shooter; a servo-lifted plate now lets it slide out. Rubber-coated shooter tubes inflated at speed and were replaced by vulcanized rubber. Note-centering wheels came just before the championship.
The trap mostly quit at the championship.

outcome.text: 66-5-1 in official play; won the Daly division, won the championship; captain of the Daly alliance on Einstein; ranked 14 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 54.09, Daly).

facts.text: Drive ratio of about 1 to 5.4
MA3 absolute encoders, 12-bit PWM; an unsigned post that reads as the team's says the move from the 10-bit analog version was not really justified

functions.name: Low packaging

solves.text: Keep the robot very low without a second mechanism for the amp

functions.type: shooter stows between the swerve modules

facts.text: Whole robot height with the shooter stowed, under
Swerve top plates were changed so the whole shooter fits between the modules
A post that reads as the team's says the tube facing the intake (50 x 25 x 3 mm 6061) bent very slightly from impacts and was replaced during pre-championship maintenance in March
The same post says the main gear plates probably took much of the impact; the area was built strong so hits would not move the plates and hurt shooting

solves.text: Take notes without exposing a mechanism outside the bumpers

facts.text: Two powered wheels center the note when it comes in at the side; diameter
Almost nothing leaves the bumpers during a match

functions.name: Trigger

solves.text: Hold a note and feed the shooter at any arm angle without another motor

functions.type: feed rollers shared with the intake motors

facts.text: The arm pivot is concentric with the intake, so a note feeds at almost any angle from travel to amp
Two infrared sensors stop the note
The 20 ms robot loop sometimes missed a sensor reading, so the intake code runs at

solves.text: One system for speaker, amp and trap that still stows low

facts.text: The note is compressed to about 0.8 of its original width
Two contact points hold the note until the last moment, which gives stability
Rollers are vulcanized rubber fused to aluminum tubes, after rubber coating on aluminum inflated at high speed

cost.text: The compression means spin cannot be added reliably

solves.text: Drive the arm with parts the team can remake and change during the season

facts.text: Steel parts made on the team's own CNC router; the idea came from 971's 2017 turret
Each pinion is two plates with steel pins between them as teeth, says an unsigned post that reads as the team's

functions.name: Note deflector

solves.text: Clear a note stuck beneath the shooter, which caused both losses before the championship

functions.type: servo-lifted plate that becomes a slide

facts.text: When the shooter closes, two servos with spoon-like prints catch the plate that protected the power distribution hub and pull it up, so notes slide out

functions.name: Climb

solves.text: Climb with something light and compact added onto the main systems

functions.type: four-bar carbon tube arms with magnet-held hooks and winches

facts.text: Arms of carbon tube and prints open straight up in a four-bar motion
Magnets hold the hooks, which pull off when the climb starts, so the arms only have to open
Winch positions are corrected from the robot's roll

functions.name: Trap mechanism

solves.text: Score the trap with the shooter used for everything else

functions.type: spring-driven trap door opener released by one servo

facts.text: One servo releases two linear slides on constant-force springs and torsion-spring fingers that open the trap door; the rest is passive
The same shooter scores the trap, in sync with the robot's swing on the chain

cost.text: The coach says the trap mostly quit at the championship

functions.name: Pose tracker

solves.text: Shoot, pick up and drive from a trusted field position instead of the camera image

functions.type: odometry, gyro and tag cameras merged by confidence

facts.text: One Limelight and two other cameras, one for notes and one for tags, the latter two on an Orange Pi with PhotonVision
Each source reports how far off it may be in meters; the positions are merged by that weight
Skids show when the translation parts of the module speeds disagree; the skidding modules are left out of the average
A collision is an accelerometer spike over

functions.name: Shooting on the move
functions.type: pose-based shot with robot velocity subtracted

facts.text: Robot velocity is subtracted from the three-dimensional shot vector
Tolerance is checked as meters missed at the target, so it is easier to meet up close
Shots run without seeing tags, which helps against defenders whose flag blocks the low camera
The championship interview says a physics model sets shooter speed and angle; the June 2024 slides say note flight was too unstable to model and describe a heuristic speed curve

functions.name: Note detection

solves.text: Recover a missed note in auto and drive to notes without overshoot

functions.type: camera that places notes in field coordinates

facts.text: Distance comes from the note's width, or from pitch when the image edge cuts the note off
The robot drives to the note's field position, which is smoother than closing a loop on the camera

decisions.choice: Stow the shooter between the swerve modules
decisions.because: it gives a low center of gravity and one system for speaker, amp and potentially trap
decisions.cost: the note is compressed so far that spin is not reliable

decisions.because: two contact points give a shot without spin more stability
it is made in the team's own workshop, so it can be changed through the season

decisions.choice: Build climb and trap on top of the main systems
decisions.because: the team would not compromise speaker, amp and fast cycles, and remembered its 2018 buddy climb

decisions.choice: Do not try to outsmart the game with a complicated design
decisions.because: 2023's robot was super complicated with no real advantage and caused burnout

decisions.choice: Weight each sensor's position by confidence
decisions.because: it is simpler to implement than a Kalman filter and still good enough

decisions.choice: Run the intake code at 5 ms
decisions.because: the 20 ms loop sometimes missed the sensor call that locates the note

decisions.choice: Keep it simple and play with a defender on Einstein
decisions.because: its alliance's offense was notably lower than the others', so out-scoring them made no sense
decisions.instead_of: a passing style, which it had tried mainly as an experiment
